architecture: Scratch one-head width64 pre attention C->W_O_pre memory drive; unchanged spatial E/I; one-head width64 post attention R queries [C,H,R]; only terminal P enters convolutional spatial-priority decoder.

lineage.architecture: One-head width-64 pre attention produces raw C and W_O_pre(C) memory drive; unchanged spatial E/I update; one-head width-64 post attention queries R over [C,H,R]; terminal P alone enters the convolutional task-specific spatial-softmax priority decoder.
